Review Google Fonts?

Reviewers largely see Google Fonts as a practical, easy-to-use font library that helps teams move faster in design and web work. Users praise its broad selection, free commercial use, simple website embedding, and options to optimize loading, while one reviewer notes it can also work well for print. The main caveats are familiar ones: its popularity can make branding feel less distinctive, quality and style depth vary across fonts, and one user avoids embedding it on websites because of privacy concerns.
